Title: GSMC to offer executive course on media engagement
NewsSummary: The eight-week course will empower participants to strategically engage with the media promoting issues, raising awareness, and fostering social change
NewsContent:
Media, in all its forms – be it journalism, digital storytelling, or strategic communication – plays a pivotal role in shaping our perspectives, influencing decisions, and driving change. In an era where information travels faster than ever before, it's not just about having access to the media; it's about understanding how to use it effectively.

In today's rapidly evolving world where information and communication are at the heart of societal progress, mastering the art of media engagement is crucial. The Aga Khan University Graduate School of Media and Communications (GSMC) recognizes this necessity and offers a transformative executive course dubbed, "Media Engagement for Impact," designed to empower individuals to harness the full potential of media for meaningful change.

The eight-week course will empower participants to strategically engage with the media promoting issues, raising awareness, and fostering social change, and is tailored to equip them with the skills and knowledge to raise your organization's profile, support crisis management and promote issues.

Why attend GSMC's Media Engagement for Impact Course?

Master the Art of Storytelling: Effective communication starts with compelling storytelling. This course delves deep into the art of narrative, equipping participants with the skills to craft engaging and impactful stories that resonate with audiences.

Creating Positive Change: The core philosophy of "Media Engagement for Impact" is rooted in the belief that media can be a catalyst for positive change. This course empowers you with the tools to address critical issues and advocate for meaningful solutions.

Networking and Collaboration: The course provides a unique opportunity to connect with like-minded individuals and industry experts, collaborate on projects and discussions that will enrich your perspective and open doors to potential partnerships.

Real-world Application: The course emphasizes practicality, with participants immersed in real-world scenarios at our state-of-the-art multimedia studios.

Expert Faculty and Resources: GSMC boasts a faculty of experienced professionals who are leaders in the field of media and communications. The course leverages this expertise and provides access to a wealth of resources.

The Media Engagement for Impact course will begin on 23rd October 2023 and will be offered in a flexible learning environment, combining in-person sessions and online classes via Zoom. At 90,000Ksh per participant, the course is suited for communications professionals, corporate and civil society managers and anyone seeking to enhance their skills in handling the media.

To apply, visit https://www.aku.edu/gsmc/events/pages/event-detail.aspx?EventID=2416&Title=Media%20Engagement%20for%20Impact​
